counter_evidence_review.outcome: Fast build with real engineering rigor: safety confirmations, false-positive avoidance, regression tests, and honest disclosure of unsigned distribution; not a low-effort dump.

notes: Native macOS utility (Swift app + CLI + menu bar) that locates the audio-producing tab or app and silences only that source, integrating Accessibility, Automation, and per-browser tab control — genuinely nontrivial platform work. Built in a two-day sprint but with a written test plan, regression tests, release automation, and unusually candid docs about permissions quirks, unsigned builds, and data-loss risk when quitting apps. Only 3 stars, which under fairness rules says nothing about quality.
